senses.gloss: m. (רָחַשׁ) moving (of lips), emotion (of the heart).—Pl. constr. רַחְשׁוּשֵׁי.
units: Men. 63ᵃ מרחשת דאתיא אר׳ הלב Ar. a. ed. Ven. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 100; ed. ארְחוּשֵׁי) the meal offering of the marḥesheth intimates that it comes to atone for the emotions of the heart (evil thoughts).

<cite ref="Menachot 63a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>אר׳ הפה</he> ed. Ven. (ed. only <he>ארחושי</he>; Ms. M. <he>ארחושי הפה</he>) for the movements of the lips, as people say, his lips are moving, v. <cite ref="T00541"><he>רְחַשׁ</he></cite>.
